description:
Audit local + remote branches for staleness. Lists branches >30 days old, merged branches with no worktree, orphaned worktrees, and branches whose remote is gone. Prioritized cleanup output.
Trigger this skill when: - User says "cleanup branches", "stale branch audit", "prune old branches", or
  invokes `/stale-branch-audit`.
- Session lands in a repo with >20 local branches. - Before switching machines / migration.
